title: Amy Acton and public-health leadership
text: Dr. Amy Acton is a graduate of my alma mater. Her lived experience of life from Y-town, Ohio and as the health director under DeWine should trump Vivek's (manufactured caricature of a politician) for the gubernatorial race in Ohio.  Separately, Sherrod Brown should have a shot if this is a wave election cycle.
